newsitem.title: USA: Alumax technology used in aluminum car.
newsitem.headline: Alumax technology used in aluminum car.

text.p: Alumax Transportation Products said its retrogression heat treatment technology was used to produce the chassis, or space frame, of the first aluminum intensive passenger car produced in North America.
The Alumax Inc business unit said a prototype of the car is being demonstrated this week at a "Ride and Drive" event hosted by Panoz Automotive Development Corp.
The Panoz Roadster on display this week will be available through Ford Motor Co's Specialty Vehicle Team dealers.
Panoz is one of a few small-volume automobile manufacturers in the United States that meets Environmental Protection Agency and Department of Transportation requirements, Alumax noted.
